problem:
Let $R=[1,7]\times [4,6]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $P$ be a partition of $R,$ where

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{1}={{x}_{0},{x}_{1},…,{x}_{m}},\,{P}_{2}={{y}_{0},{y}_{1},…,{y}_{n}},\,P={P}_{1}\times {P}_{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Calculate the double integral

$$
{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A,
$$

where $f$ is a function such that ${m}_{ij}={M}_{ij}=6$ for all partitions $P$ of $R,$ and ${m}_{ij}$ and ${M}_{ij}$ are the minimum and maximum values of $f$ respectively in each subregion ${R}_{ij}.$

activity_context.topic_title: Defining Double Integrals Using Lower and Upper Riemann Sums

feedback.problem:
Let $R=[1,4]\times [1,4]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $P$ be a partition of $R,$ where

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{1}={{x}_{0},{x}_{1},…,{x}_{m}},\,{P}_{2}={{y}_{0},{y}_{1},…,{y}_{n}},\,P={P}_{1}\times {P}_{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Calculate the double integral

$$
{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A,
$$

where $f$ is a function such that ${m}_{ij}={M}_{ij}=-2$ for all partitions $P$ of $R,$ and ${m}_{ij}$ and ${M}_{ij}$ are the minimum and maximum values of $f$ respectively in each subregion ${R}_{ij}.$
feedback.worked_solution:
For a function $f(x,y),$ the double integral of $f$ over a rectangular region $R$ is the unique number $I$ (if it exists) such that

$$
L(f,P)\le I\le U(f,P),
$$

over all partitions $P$ of $R,$ where the lower and upper sums respectively are given by

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}{m}_{ij}Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} \\ U(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}{M}_{ij}Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}\end{aligned}
$$

and ${m}_{ij}$ and ${M}_{ij}$ are the minimum and maximum values of $f$ in each subregion ${R}_{ij}.$ 

Now, since ${m}_{ij}={M}_{ij}=-2,$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P)=U(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}(-2)\,Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} \\  & =-2({\sum }_{i=1}^{m}Δ{x}_{i})({\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{y}_{j}) \\  & =-2(4-1)(4-1) \\  & =-2\cdot 3\cdot 3 \\  & =-18.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we obtain

$$
L(f,P)=-18\le {∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A\le -18=U(f,P)
$$

which implies that

$$
{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A=-18.
$$
